observations: Photo 0 shows a complete Toyota-style engine bay assembly on the ground, with visible intake/exhaust plumbing and multiple hoses/wiring harnesses.
Photo 1 shows the engine from another angle with the intake manifold/airbox area and more of the wiring/hose routing visible.
Photo 2 shows the engine with the large upper cover/airbox area and additional components; a turbo/charger-looking unit is not clearly identifiable from these angles.
Across photos, the engine appears to be a V6-family layout (multiple banks/large displacement look), but the exact engine code/model is not readable.

identity.kind: complete used car engine assembly (with related components)

claims.claim: Complete engine with compressor and all the operators for toyota venza,camry, sienna, Hylander,...
claims.evidence: Photos show an engine assembly with hoses/wiring and some attached components, but the compressor (A/C compressor) and the full list of 'operators' (exact parts included) are not clearly identifiable from the images provided.

risks.risk: Wrong engine variant/engine code for the listed Toyota models (Venza/Camry/Sienna/Highlander can use different engines and accessory layouts).
risks.proof: A clear photo of the engine code/ID plate (usually on the engine block or cylinder head) and the VIN/engine code match for the donor vehicle.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a generic used engine assembly with compatibility risk (worst case: may not fit or may require extra parts).

risks.risk: A/C compressor may be missing or not included (seller says 'with compressor').
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the A/C compressor body with its pulley and mounting bracket, plus a photo showing it physically attached to the assembly.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as without A/C compressor (worst case: buyer must source compressor separately).

risks.risk: Not tested / unknown running condition (could be seized, noisy, or have internal issues).
risks.proof: Video of a cold start (or at least a running test) and/or compression test results.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not working / unknown condition (worst case: overhaul or major repairs needed).

risks.risk: Missing 'operators' (could mean sensors, ECU, alternator, starter, belts, hoses, brackets, or other required modules).
risks.proof: A laid-out parts checklist photo showing every included item, labeled, and confirmation of ECU/major sensors included (if applicable).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as incomplete (worst case: buyer must replace missing sensors/modules).

risks.risk: Transmission/gearbox not included or mismatched (photos show engine + some drivetrain parts, but gearbox compatibility is unclear).
risks.proof: Photo showing the full mating surface and any attached transmission/transfer case, plus the transmission model code.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as engine-only or mismatched assembly risk (worst case: additional gearbox/adapter work).

proof_requests: Clear photo of the engine code/ID stamped on the block/head (and any label/plate).
Close-up photo confirming the A/C compressor is included and attached (pulley + mounting).
Video of the engine running (or compression test results).
A complete parts list photo: what exactly is included under 'all the operators' (ECU, alternator, starter, sensors, hoses, brackets, etc.).
Photo showing whether a transmission is included, and its code/model.
response.reason: The photos show a used engine assembly, but the exact engine identity and whether the A/C compressor and all required included parts are present cannot be confirmed remotely. Without engine code and running/condition proof, a reliable worst-case price cannot be set.
